invariants.name: Each merge except the last runs at most one session boundary
A graduated row leaves live rows only with a resolving ADR heading

abstraction.hides: The domain record stage ownership across S3 to S6, the removal of plan export and plan drift sync modules, the trail parser placement in trail.ts, and the 4-line session handoff formatter.
callersKnow: astack plan export and astack plan drift exit 2, while astack plan keys, astack board and astack session resume stay intact.
astack session handoff returns a 4-line comment with no open-question count.
The plan skill holds 11 files under 8,000 words with S3 to S6 owning the domain record.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without ADR 0037 cuts and stage ownership, plan carries 14,684 words of repeated checker rules, 1,068 lines of unused export/drift sync code, and a handoff line that hides waiting items behind a count.

alternatives.name: Keep plan export and plan drift as opt-in commands
alternatives.rejectedBecause: They add 1,068 lines and 1,171 words for low use and high defect rate.

alternatives.name: Cut astack plan keys together with export
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Filed programme decision issues still need key write-back into plan files.

alternatives.name: Print up to 3 open questions in the handoff comment
alternatives.rejectedBecause: That duplicates Catch up inside a tracker comment.

omitted: PlanBoundary does not model plan export/drift removal, skill word counts or handoff line counts. The PLAN-CUT, PLAN-RECORD and HANDOFF-COUNT controls enforce those invariants.
Tracker JSON parsing for board and session resume stays outside the model and is guarded by plan-tracker.test.ts and plan-session.test.ts.

bounds: Three sessions, two decision rows and four heading forms.
Each order of the merge, boundary, resume, ADR write and graduate steps.

negative.defect: A check that drops the heading test lets a row leave the live rows with an ADR heading that does not resolve.

limits: Static text controls prove stage pointers and removed terms, not live agent plan quality.
src/astack/profile.ts continues to accept plan.team until product profiles migrate.
Exact-head CI, review, Shipping and every ordinary gate stay required.
